title: Capabilities
description: A capability file: the outbound hosts, key-value stores, variables and providers an operator grants a holo. Nothing is granted unless an allow entry matches and no deny entry does. The runtime applies the set named default unless told otherwise. Design: docs/proposals/279-capability-sets.md and docs/proposals/294-provider-services.md.

sets.description: Named capability sets. default is required.

set.description: One set. A missing member is an empty list. A deny entry wins over an allow entry of the same kind.

hosts.description: Origins, scheme://host[:port], lower case. scheme, host and port may be *, and host may start with *. to match every subdomain. With no port only the scheme's default port matches.

stores.description: Key-value store labels, or * for every store.

variables.description: Variable names, or * for every variable.

providers.description: Provider types, or * for every provider. A provider is the executable prism-provider-<type>, which runs as the user, outside the holo.
